summary: Two tightly-coupled increments. (A) A streamed-vs-resident logit-diff harness: an additive resident FFI returns the llama.cpp logit vector at the final prompt position, and a pure-Rust metrics module quantifies the difference against the streamed decoder's step-0 logits. (B) K-quant decoder support (Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K) plus the Q5_0/Q5_1 32-element fallbacks, enabled by replacing the hardcoded 32-element block check with ggml_blck_size and broadening the type allowlist; all dequant/dot kernels remain the pinned ggml traits. Genuine K-quant fixtures were derived with the pinned llama-quantize and run through streamed inference: output is byte-identical to the resident reference, logits agree on top-1 and top-10, and execution stays out-of-core under a 32 MB address-space limit.

source.git_dirty_at_record: doc-comment corrections (streamed.rs, llmbridge.h) and this evidence file pending commit; .vscode/ untracked
source.note: Validation binaries were built from the working tree committed across the four commits above; only doc comments and this evidence changed afterward (no decoder behaviour change).

objective_a_logit_diff_harness.native_api: llmbridge_resident_prompt_logits_v1 (additive, ABI version unchanged, exceptions caught): loads the model, tokenizes with add_special+parse_special (identical to the streamed path and to generate()), decodes the prompt with output logits at the final position, and emits the full n_vocab logit vector once. Samples/generates nothing.
objective_a_logit_diff_harness.position_equivalence: Streamed step-0 logits (after prefilling tokens[0..n-1], predicting token[n]) are compared against resident llama_get_logits_ith(ctx,-1) at the same final prompt position with identical tokenization.
objective_a_logit_diff_harness.metrics_module: crates/llmbridge-core/src/logit_diff.rs computes max/mean absolute error, RMSE, max relative error (denominator floor 1e-6), top-1 agreement, top-k overlap, and the selected-token rank of each backend's argmax within the other's logits. Non-finite values are counted, never hidden. 4 CI-safe unit tests.
objective_a_logit_diff_harness.cli: Opt-in `llmbridge logit-diff <model> --prompt <text> [--ctx --threads --top-k --workspace-mb]`; normal `chat` inference is unchanged.
objective_a_logit_diff_harness.key_finding: Token parity is NOT logit equivalence. The streamed decoder is an independent custom FP32 forward pass; its logits differ measurably from llama.cpp's graph even where the greedy token sequence is identical.
objective_a_logit_diff_harness.note_max_rel_err: The large max relative error is an artefact of near-zero reference logits divided by the 1e-6 floor; the absolute error, RMSE, and rank metrics are the meaningful signals here.

objective_b_kquant.decoder_change: native/src/streamed.cpp: streamed_supported_type() admits {F32, Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K}; the geometry check now uses ggml_blck_size(type) (F32=1, 32-element quants=32, K-quant superblocks=256) instead of a hardcoded 32. Dequant (to_float) and matvec (vec_dot via the Q8_0/Q8_1/Q8_K activation path) are the pinned ggml reference traits; no hand-written K-quant kernels were added.
objective_b_kquant.kernel_delegation_confirmed: Each admitted type decodes real weights through ggml_get_type_traits(type)->to_float and ggml_get_type_traits_cpu(type)->vec_dot; the existing dynamic checks reject any type whose traits or activation quantizer are unavailable.
objective_b_kquant.fixture_derivation: Genuine K-quant fixtures were produced from the committed q8_0 stories15M model with the pinned llama-quantize --allow-requantize (q8_0->K-quant and q8_0->F16 are otherwise disabled by llama.cpp). Fixtures are gitignored and NOT committed.
objective_b_kquant.stories15M_288_dim_constraint: stories15M embedding_length is 288, which is not a multiple of the 256-element K-quant superblock, so only ffn_down (ne0=768 = 3 superblocks) becomes a genuine K-quant tensor; sub-256-wide tensors fall back to 32-element quants. The fixtures are therefore MIXED-quant and genuinely exercise the K-quant dequant+matvec path on the ffn_down tensors, but are not all-K-quant models. A fully-K-quant dense-llama needs all dims divisible by 256 (e.g. stories110M, not downloaded this session).

bounded_memory.interpretation: Each ~21-26 MB K-quant model streams >128 MB of weight reads in <=65 KB ranges and runs in a 32 MB address space at ~14-14.8 MB peak RSS with zero cache allocation. Out-of-core bounded memory is preserved for K-quant formats; weights are never fully resident.

security_and_correctness_preserved.note: The decoder change only widens the admitted tensor-type set and generalizes the block-size check; authentication, sealed-manifest verification, source-mutation detection, deadline/cancellation, worker lifecycle, memory admission, and the isfinite guards are unchanged. The resident logit API is a separate opt-in diagnostic path and does not touch normal inference. ABI version unchanged.

limitations: K-quant validation used MIXED-quant fixtures: only ffn_down (ne0=768) is a genuine K-quant superblock tensor because stories15M's 288-wide tensors cannot be K-quantized. A fully-K-quant model (dims divisible by 256, e.g. stories110M) was not obtained this session.

Fixtures were derived with llama-quantize --allow-requantize from an already-q8_0 model (lossy source); this is valid for parity (streamed and resident decode identical bytes) but the fixtures are not independently published upstream models.
Parity is deterministic greedy tokens PLUS a quantitative logit diff at the first generated position; multi-position logit diffs were not collected.
WSL2 virtualized, not physical 2 GB/dual-core hardware; memory numbers are address-space/RSS bounds.
cgroup memory.max enforcement not tested (no passwordless sudo); RLIMIT_AS used as the enforced bound.
Windows native (MSVC) regression lane not run this session.
